title: NVIDIA GPU 指令发射与延迟隐藏机制
summary: 单个 warp 按 SASS 顺序发射，编译器重排独立指令，scheduler 跨 warp 选择 eligible 工作，scoreboard 跟踪依赖。所有候选都无法填充 issue slot 时才形成 bubble，NCU sampling 与 scheduler 统计验证该条件。
title_en: NVIDIA GPU Instruction Issue and Latency Hiding
summary_en: Per-warp issue follows final SASS order, while the compiler statically reorders independent work, the scheduler selects eligible work across resident warps, and scoreboards track runtime completion dependencies. Latency becomes an issue bubble only when no candidate fills the slot; Nsight Compute All and Not-issued samples require Scheduler Statistics for that conclusion.

title: NVIDIA GPU 访存层级与 Nsight Compute 数据通路模型
summary: NCU Memory Chart 用 request、sector 与 wavefront 表示 global load 经 LSU、L1TEX、L2 到显存分区的路径。层级计数定位流量放大与 cache miss，GNIC、LRC、FBPA 等仅按公开证据解释。
title_en: NVIDIA GPU Memory Hierarchy and the Nsight Compute Data-Path Model
summary_en: Nsight Compute's Memory Chart represents an ordinary global load through LSU, L1TEX, L2, and memory-side partitions using requests, sectors, wavefronts, and throughput metrics. Comparing adjacent levels localizes traffic amplification and cache misses, while interpretations of GNIC, LRC, FBPA, and related units remain bounded by public definitions, metric direction, and cited patent embodiments.

title: GPU MIO Throttle：队列反压、成因与诊断
summary: MIO Throttle 是 MIO queue 无法接收下一条 shared-memory、special-math 或动态分支指令时的发射前等待。离散排队模型描述短时 burst 与排空能力的失配，NCU 与 SASS 证据用于判断性能影响。
title_en: GPU MIO Throttle: Queue Backpressure, Causes, and Diagnosis
summary_en: MIO Throttle is a pre-issue wait caused when the MIO instruction queue cannot accept a pending shared-memory, special-math, or dynamic-branch instruction. A discrete queueing model relates the stall to burst arrivals versus drain capacity, while Not-issued samples, SASS opcodes, and backend metrics determine whether the pressure affects kernel time.

title: GPU Scoreboard 机制：Warp 依赖跟踪、SASS 控制与 Long/Short Stall
summary: GPU scoreboard 维护可变延迟操作依赖，SASS identifier 与 wait mask 决定 warp 是否 eligible。Long/Short 由 L1TEX 或 MIO producer 路径决定，NCU 依赖边可将 consumer 追溯到 producer。
title_en: GPU Scoreboard Mechanism: Warp Dependency Tracking, SASS Control, and Long/Short Stalls
summary_en: GPU scoreboards maintain dynamic dependency state for operations whose completion time cannot be scheduled statically. Producer identifiers and consumer wait masks connect SASS controls to scheduler eligibility; Nsight Compute then classifies waits by L1TEX or non-L1TEX MIO producer path and traces a stalled consumer back to its producer.

title: Kernel Design Agents 与 KernelWiki：面向 GPU Kernel 优化的证据驱动工作流
summary: GPU kernel 优化受正确性、可比较测量和目标架构约束，agent 搜索也增加证据管理成本。KDA 固定任务契约并记录候选决策，KernelWiki 提供带版本和来源的知识线索；当前实现仍须由本地 validation、benchmark 与 profile 验证。
title_en: Kernel Design Agents and KernelWiki: An Evidence-Driven Workflow for GPU Kernel Optimization
summary_en: GPU kernel optimization must satisfy input-domain correctness, comparable measurement, and target-architecture constraints; agent-driven search also increases the cost of evidence management. KDA fixes the task contract and records candidate decisions, while KernelWiki supplies versioned, sourced hypotheses. Local validation, benchmarks, and profiles still determine whether a technique works for the current kernel.

title: CUDA Named Barrier：CTA 内分组同步与 Occupancy 约束
summary: PTX named barrier 为同一 CTA 的完整 warp 组维护带编号、按 generation 复用的到达状态。参与计数、aligned 约束与 ID 所有权决定同步正确性，NCU launch metric 给出其对 resident block 数的静态限制。
title_en: CUDA Named Barriers: CTA-Local Synchronization and Occupancy Constraints
summary_en: PTX named barriers provide numbered, generation-reused arrival state for selected full warps within one CTA, enabling producer-consumer handoffs without a full-CTA rendezvous. Correctness follows from participant counts, alignment rules, and ID ownership, while Nsight Compute barrier launch metrics expose the compiled resource limit on resident blocks.

title: GPU Warp Stall 分析：调度状态、Nsight Compute 指标与源码归因
summary: NCU warp-state metric 记录 scheduler readiness 与 stall reason，高数值本身不证明 issue slot 已空置。可靠归因需联合调度统计、Not-issued sampling、SASS 依赖与子系统指标。
title_en: GPU Warp Stall Analysis: Scheduler States, Nsight Compute Metrics, and Source Attribution
summary_en: Nsight Compute warp-state metrics describe both scheduler readiness and the reasons individual warps wait, but a large stall value alone does not establish an exposed issue gap. Reliable attribution combines Scheduler Statistics, Not-issued PC sampling, SASS producer-consumer dependencies, and subsystem counters while respecting the sampling and normalization semantics.

title: GPU Occupancy 的驻留资源模型与性能含义
summary: CUDA kernel 的 occupancy 由 SM 可接纳的完整 thread block 数决定，各类驻留资源的最小上限约束 resident warp 数。整数装箱模型解释 block size 的锯齿变化，并区分 NCU 的理论值、实测值与 launch limiter。
title_en: GPU Occupancy: Residency Resource Model and Performance Interpretation
summary_en: CUDA occupancy is determined by the number of complete thread blocks an SM can admit, with warp slots, registers, shared memory, block slots, and barrier state imposing separate residency limits. An integer-packing model explains nonmonotonic block-size effects and relates Nsight Compute launch limiters to theoretical and achieved occupancy.

title: Triton JIT Specialization 机制：参数特化、编译变体与缓存
summary: Triton JIT specialization 按参数类型、constexpr、对齐属性和编译选项划分等价类，同一 key 复用 kernel。固定版本源码表明 Tensor shape 不随普通 pointer 进入 key，两级 cache 与 autotune 共同决定变体数。
title_en: Triton JIT Specialization: Arguments, Kernel Variants, and Caching
summary_en: Triton JIT specialization partitions calls into compilation-equivalence classes keyed by argument types, constexpr values, alignment properties, and compilation options. The pinned implementation shows why ordinary tensor shapes do not automatically enter pointer keys, how in-process and persistent caches are queried, and how specialization combines with autotune to determine variant count.

title: 四路组相联 Cache 的地址映射与 LRU 替换
summary: 四路组相联 Cache 先由 index 选择 set，再由替换策略选择 way。对 256 组的严格 LRU 模型，扫描 line 0–1023 后，set s 保存 s、s+256、s+512、s+768；line 1024 只与 set 0 冲突，并淘汰 line 0。
title_en: Address Mapping and LRU Replacement in a Four-Way Set-Associative Cache
summary_en: Four-way set-associative caches use address index bits to select a set, then a fill or replacement policy to choose one way. In the stated 256-set strict-LRU model, scanning lines 0–1023 leaves set s with s, s+256, s+512, and s+768; line 1024 conflicts only in set 0 and evicts line 0.

title: LayerNorm 反向传播：数学推导、CUDA 规约与 Triton 融合实现
summary: LayerNorm 反向含两条正交规约：dX 沿 feature 维，dweight 与 dbias 沿样本行。闭式梯度对应 PyTorch CUDA kernel；Triton 路径融合 dX 与参数梯度 partial sum，再由第二个 kernel 规约 FP32 缓冲区。
title_en: LayerNorm Backpropagation: Derivation, CUDA Reductions, and Triton Fusion
summary_en: LayerNorm backward contains two orthogonal reductions: dX reduces across normalized features within each row, whereas dweight and dbias reduce across rows. The closed-form gradients map directly to PyTorch native CUDA kernels; the examined Triton implementation fuses dX with parameter-gradient partial sums and uses a second kernel to reduce FP32 temporary buffers.

title: PyTorch DDP 梯度规约机制：Reducer、Bucket 与 NCCL AllReduce
summary: 标准 DDP 需把各 rank 的局部梯度变成一致的完整副本。PyTorch 2.12 Reducer 以 bucket 为 collective 单位，预除 div_factor 后发起 SUM AllReduce；bucket 数对应逻辑 collective 数，NCCL kernel 数、custom hook 缩放和分片语义须另行判断。
title_en: Gradient Reduction in PyTorch DDP: Reducer, Buckets, and NCCL AllReduce
summary_en: Standard DDP must turn independently computed local parameter gradients into identical full gradients on every rank. In PyTorch 2.12, the Reducer launches one logical collective per ready bucket in a consistent order and divides by div_factor before SUM AllReduce; bucket count, lower-level NCCL kernel count, custom-hook scaling, and sharded-gradient ownership remain distinct concerns.

title: PyTorch Autograd 反向图模型：grad_fn、next_functions 与 AccumulateGrad
summary: 分支计算会让多份梯度汇入同一 Node，而 leaf Tensor 仍保持 grad_fn=None。PyTorch 2.12 eager autograd 按 next_functions 槽位完成 fan-in 累加，再由 AccumulateGrad 写入 leaf.grad；固定版本 Megatron-Core 借临时 view 挂接 DDP hook。
title_en: The PyTorch Autograd Reverse Graph: grad_fn, next_functions, and AccumulateGrad
summary_en: Branched computations and shared tensors send multiple gradient contributions to one upstream node, while leaf tensors retain grad_fn=None. PyTorch 2.12 eager autograd aggregates fan-in contributions through the node-and-slot relationships exposed by next_functions, then writes leaf gradients through AccumulateGrad; the pinned Megatron-Core implementation reaches that node through a temporary non-leaf view to attach its DDP hook.

title: 现代 LLM MoE 架构：路由、分发与融合执行
summary: 现代 sparse MoE 用 top-k 将 token 分配给少量 expert，使模型容量与单 token 计算量分别扩展。运行时还需索引、重排、GroupedGEMM、加权回填和 all-to-all；MegaMoE 改变量化与融合 contract，不改变路由方程。
title_en: Modern LLM MoE Architectures: Routing, Dispatch, and Fused Execution
summary_en: Modern sparse MoE routes each token to a small expert subset, decoupling total parameter capacity from per-token activated compute. Runtime execution still requires token-to-expert indexing, permutation, GroupedGEMM, weighted restoration, and cross-GPU all-to-all; MegaMoE changes the quantization and fusion contract of these stages without changing the routing equation.

title: SiLU 的 tanh 与 exp2 实现：指令依赖与验证方法
summary: SiLU 的 sigmoid/exp2 与 tanh 恒等式在实数域等价，却形成不同 GPU 依赖链；前者包含 reciprocal/divide，后者用 FMUL/FFMA 完成缩放。性能判断须同时满足固定编译条件下的 SASS、数值误差与 kernel duration 证据。
title_en: SiLU Implementations with tanh and exp2: Instruction Dependencies and Validation
summary_en: SiLU's sigmoid/exp2 and tanh identities are equivalent over the reals but lower to different GPU dependency chains: the former includes reciprocal or division, whereas the latter uses ordinary FMUL/FFMA around tanh. Any performance claim must be supported by generated SASS, numerical-error measurements, and kernel timing under fixed compiler settings.

title: Codex 会话持久化机制：rollout JSONL 与 SQLite 状态库
summary: Codex 分别持久化会话事件、可恢复状态、日志和 memory，因此 ~/.codex 同时包含 rollout JSONL、SQLite 与 WAL。公开接口只保证逻辑职责；state_5.sqlite 等文件名和 schema 属于版本实现，排障与披露应按数据职责判断。
title_en: Codex Session Persistence: Rollout JSONL and SQLite State
summary_en: Codex persists conversation events, resumable state, diagnostics, and memory as separate concerns, so ~/.codex contains rollout JSONL, SQLite databases, and WAL support files. Public interfaces guarantee these logical responsibilities, not filenames or schemas such as state_5.sqlite; troubleshooting and disclosure decisions should follow data roles rather than extensions.

title: PyTorch Linear 与 cuBLAS GEMM 的布局对应
summary: row-major Tensor 与 cuBLAS column-major 接口会把同一缓冲区解释为转置矩阵，profiler 的 TN、NT、NN 不能直接按 Linear 公式读取。该变换确定前向、wgrad、dgrad 的操作数与规约轴；结论限于二维连续布局，不代表 ATen 的 backend 选择。
title_en: PyTorch Linear and cuBLAS GEMM Layout Mapping
summary_en: PyTorch Linear's row-major tensors and the cuBLAS column-major interface interpret the same buffer as transposed matrix views, so profiler labels such as TN, NT, and NN cannot be read directly from model equations. The view transformation determines operand order, transpose modes, and reduction axes for forward, wgrad, and dgrad under contiguous two-dimensional assumptions, independent of ATen's backend choice.

title: FP8 缩放机制与训练 Recipe
summary: FP8 数值由量化码与 scale 共同定义，recipe 决定粒度和更新策略。MXFP8 沿 GEMM K 轴分块并累加到 FP32；TE v2.16 重新量化 attention 输入，不支持 fp8_mha=True 的 MXFP8 FusedAttention 后端。
title_en: FP8 Scaling Mechanisms and Training Recipes
summary_en: FP8 values acquire their numerical meaning together with scale metadata; a training recipe fixes the format, scale granularity, amax update, and operator boundaries. MXFP8 places block scales along GEMM reduction axes and accumulates MMA results in FP32, while Transformer Engine v2.16 requantizes Q/K/V at the attention boundary and disables the MXFP8 FusedAttention path when fp8_mha=True.

title: PyTorch record_stream 与 CUDA Storage 复用
summary: CUDA 异步执行可能让 Tensor 生命周期早于 GPU 对 storage 的最后访问，形成跨 stream 复用风险。record_stream 向 caching allocator 登记 side-stream 使用，使 block 等待 event 完成后再复用；wait_stream 另行约束执行顺序。
title_en: PyTorch record_stream and CUDA Storage Reuse
summary_en: CUDA's asynchronous execution can end a tensor's Python lifetime before the GPU's final access to its storage, creating a cross-stream reuse hazard. record_stream reports side-stream use to the native caching allocator so the block remains pending until recorded events complete; wait_stream or CUDA events separately establish execution order.

title: Sliding Window Attention 的 Packing 边界与样本隔离
summary: Sequence packing 提高 token 利用率，SWA 只限制层内依赖，不编码样本边界。L 层因果 SWA 的感受野上界为 L(W-1)+1；document mask 或 cu_seqlens 必须切断跨样本路径，保证 packed attention 的样本隔离。
title_en: Packing Boundaries and Sample Isolation in Sliding Window Attention
summary_en: Sequence packing improves token utilization, while Sliding Window Attention constrains only local dependencies within each layer and does not encode sample ownership. The maximum theoretical receptive field of L causal SWA layers is L(W-1)+1; document masks or cu_seqlens must disconnect packed samples to preserve attention equivalence with separate execution.

title: PyTorch AOTInductor 的 CUDA C++ 部署与运行时机制
summary: AOTInductor 离线完成模型捕获、lowering、GPU kernel 生成与 .pt2 打包，再由匹配版本的 libtorch C++ loader 执行。PyTorch v2.12.0 的调用链界定 archive、runner 和 custom op 的双阶段契约；文件名、ELF 依赖及生成符号不属于稳定 ABI。
title_en: CUDA C++ Deployment and Runtime Mechanics of PyTorch AOTInductor
summary_en: AOTInductor moves model capture, lowering, GPU-kernel generation, and packaging into an offline stage, leaving deployment to execute a .pt2 artifact through a matching libtorch C++ loader. The PyTorch v2.12.0 call path defines the compile-time and runtime contracts for archives, runners, and custom operators, while internal file names, ELF dependencies, and generated symbols remain version-dependent rather than stable ABI.

title: LLM 序列混合机制分类与模型谱系
summary: LLM 报告中的 MHA、SWA、Mamba 分属计算形式、KV 组织与正交结构，单一演进线会混淆层级。谱系以序列混合形式为主坐标，规定 dense、sparse、linear/stateful 与混合模型的归档规则，并标记公开证据不足的 2025 至 2026 年节点。
title_en: LLM Sequence-Mixing Mechanisms: A Taxonomy and Model Lineage
summary_en: Terms such as MHA, SWA, and Mamba describe different coordinates: computation form, KV organization, or orthogonal structure. The taxonomy uses sequence-mixing form as its primary axis, defines placement rules for dense, sparse, linear/stateful, and hybrid models, and retains verification markers for 2025–2026 nodes with limited public evidence.

title: PyTorch Linux 共享库的构建与加载关系
summary: Linux CUDA wheel 把核心类型、CPU/CUDA 算子和 Python binding 分置于多个共享库。v2.12.0 的 CMake target 给出 c10 至 torch_python 的构建层次；实际装载仍由 ELF DT_NEEDED 与 RTLD_GLOBAL 决定，须以安装产物核验。
title_en: Build and Load Relationships of PyTorch Linux Shared Libraries
summary_en: Linux CUDA wheels distribute PyTorch core types, CPU and CUDA operators, and Python bindings across several shared libraries, so import behavior depends on both build topology and ELF dependencies. PyTorch v2.12.0 CMake targets establish the link hierarchy from c10 through torch_python, while final DT_NEEDED entries and RTLD_GLOBAL preload behavior remain properties of the installed artifacts.

title: Hopper Thread Block Cluster 的执行语义：DSMEM、Cluster Barrier 与跨 CTA TMA
summary: Hopper Thread Block Cluster 将若干 CTA 共调度到同一 GPC，并以 barrier、DSMEM 与 mbarrier/TMA 状态实现跨 CTA 协作。CUDA 12.6.3 和 PTX ISA 8.5 规定可观察语义，资源分派与物理路由不在公开保证内。
title_en: Execution Semantics of Hopper Thread Block Clusters: DSMEM, Cluster Barriers, and Cross-CTA TMA
summary_en: Hopper Thread Block Clusters co-schedule several CTAs on one GPC and provide cluster-scope barriers, DSMEM addressing, and mbarrier/TMA completion state for cross-CTA protocols. CUDA 12.6.3 and PTX ISA 8.5 define shape, launch, synchronization, and address semantics, while resource allocation and physical routing remain outside the public contract.

title: Context Parallel 的通信方法与实现约束
summary: Context Parallel 将长序列沿 token 维分布到多个 rank，全局 attention 仍需恢复完整 K/V。统一模型给出 AllGather、Ring、Ulysses 与二维方案的通信扩展边界，并区分 head 整除、因果负载和拓扑相关条件。
title_en: Communication Methods and Implementation Constraints in Context Parallelism
summary_en: Context parallelism distributes one long sequence across ranks while global attention still requires the complete K/V context. A common communication-compute model exposes the scaling limits of AllGather, Ring, Ulysses, and two-dimensional schemes, separating head-divisibility and causal-load constraints from topology-dependent performance choices.

title: PyTorch Dispatcher 的多维分派与算子执行路径
summary: 设备、layout、autograd 与 mode 会共同改变同一 ATen 算子的运行时语义。v2.12.0 以 schema 固定契约，由 DispatchKeySet 选取实现，再经 redispatch 进入 backend；aten::add.Tensor 的 CUDA 前后向路径验证该模型。
title_en: PyTorch Dispatcher: Multidimensional Dispatch and Operator Execution
summary_en: One ATen operator can be governed simultaneously by device, layout, autograd, tensor-subclass, and thread-local mode semantics. In PyTorch v2.12.0, schemas fix the operator contract, ordered DispatchKeySets select registered implementations, and redispatch composes wrapper layers with the backend; the CUDA forward and backward path of aten::add.Tensor identifies where generated code enters execution.

title: PyTorch TorchDispatchMode 的双向调度机制
summary: Python handler 可借 TorchDispatchMode 改写 ATen 语义，并继续进入 dispatcher。v2.12.0 的 Python key、PyInterpreterVTable 与 mode 暂存构成可重入回路，也划定 mode、tensor subclass 及无 CPython 进程的适用范围。
title_en: Bidirectional Dispatch with PyTorch TorchDispatchMode
summary_en: TorchDispatchMode lets FakeTensor, proxy tracing, and distributed tensors override ATen semantics in Python while retaining the C++ dispatcher's priority and redispatch rules. In PyTorch v2.12.0, the Python key, PyInterpreterVTable, PyObjectSlot, and mode stashing form a re-entrant C++/Python loop whose boundaries differ for modes, tensor subclasses, and processes without CPython.

title: OneTrans 与 YaMBDA 的数据处理流程与特征组织
summary: OneTrans 将 YaMBDA 事件变为 ScoringPair：行为历史经 KJT 和 embedding lookup 生成 S-token，非序列特征组成 NS-token。Shape 推导表明序列长度主导三张 native 表查询，NS-token 在金字塔裁剪中始终保留。
title_en: OneTrans and YaMBDA: Data Processing Flow and Feature Organization
summary_en: OneTrans converts YaMBDA events into target-event ScoringPairs. Behavior histories pass through KJT assembly and embedding lookup to form S-tokens, while scalar embeddings and dense features form NS-tokens. Shape derivations at the pinned commit show that sequence length dominates lookups to the three native embedding tables and that NS-tokens survive every pyramid-trimming stage.

title: Python Import 机制：绝对导入与相对导入
summary: Python import 解析模块全名与 package 上下文，磁盘相对位置不足以确定导入结果。Python 3.14 中，sys.modules、sys.path、__spec__.parent 与 package.__path__ 共同决定绝对/相对名称和 namespace package 的查找，也解释了直接运行与 python -m 的差异。
title_en: Python Import Mechanism: Absolute vs Relative
summary_en: Python import resolution operates on fully qualified module names and package context; relative file placement alone does not determine the result. Under Python 3.14 semantics, sys.modules, sys.path, __spec__.parent, and package.__path__ jointly resolve absolute and relative names, namespace packages, and the behavioral difference between direct file execution and python -m.

title: GEMM Arithmetic Intensity 的分块模型与适用边界
summary: GEMM 的 arithmetic intensity 必须相对于具体存储边界定义；矩形 tile 的单层渐近结果为 H(M_t,N_t)/b，较短边限制 operand 复用。该式是流量上界而非 kernel 排名，L2 复用、工作分解与融合收益仍需独立模型或固定环境测量。
title_en: GEMM Arithmetic Intensity: Blocking Models and Their Limits
summary_en: GEMM arithmetic intensity must be defined at a specific memory boundary. A single-level blocking model gives the rectangular-tile asymptote H(M_t,N_t)/b, showing that the shorter output-tile edge limits operand reuse; L2 reuse, work decomposition, fusion benefits, and measured throughput require separate traffic models or experiments on a fixed configuration.
